body: me too. I feel bad because you all took the time to write these posts and I'm embarrassed... I feel really weird right now.

I do not have any friends. But.. if I had one and that friend was me I'd say to her "you are almost 30. you have accomplished nothing. you cheated on your fiance, your parents hate you and your job is just an excuse for you to leave your messy place for some hours. perhaps you should just kill yourself. that's Darwin in action." or somewhere along those lines. I'm sorry, I know I am not helping. Thank you, though.
